title: mcp-server-git git_init tool escapes the --repository confinement (creates repos at any path)
attacker_story: The user granted the agent one repository via --repository /srv/repo; a prompt-injected model calls git_init with an absolute path outside it. The scripted MCP host forwards the model's tool call verbatim over stdio.

oracle.description: a .git directory was created at /srv/outside/<nonce>, outside the server's --repository confinement
